About.title: Frontend Developer, 4+ years of experience
text: Frontend Developer with over 4 years of commercial experience. Deep expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Next.js. Specializes in architecting complex interfaces (Next.js/React), performance optimization (Core Web Vitals), and Headless CMS integration.
Regularly conducts performance audits (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals), updates dependencies, tracks security patches, and implements modern development practices.

works.summary: Developed high-load corporate admin panels and multilingual e-commerce sites. Responsible for the full frontend development lifecycle, from architecture design to performance optimization, UI library creation, and security implementation.
description: Designed and developed several high-load web applications with a focus on loading speed
Developed and maintained automated tests for critical scenarios
Implemented and evolved a corporate UI library (dependency management, versioning)
Adapted an e-commerce template into a React Native mobile application (touch handling, mobile screens)
Designed and implemented a product configurator with dynamic attribute settings, dependent option logic, and automatic price recalculation
Optimized handling of large data objects: implemented memoization, list virtualization, and lazy loading
Integrated client-side payment systems
Optimized the bundle: code splitting, dependency analysis using Bundle Analyzer
Implemented web analytics systems (Google Analytics, Yandex.Metrica)
Maintained technical project documentation: README, JSDoc, setup and launch guides
Used AI assistants (Cursor) for automatic dependency updates, refactoring, and code synchronization in micro-frontend projects
achievements: Optimized rendering through component caching and Streaming SSR, achieving consistent Core Web Vitals pass rates across all device types
Implemented multi-layered form protection (Rate Limiting + reCAPTCHA), completely blocking automated spam
Integrated authentication via a corporate OAuth service
works.technologies: TypeScript, React, Next, Vue, Nuxt, React Native, Redux Toolkit, Next Auth, Next Intl, Zustand, Shadcn, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, PHP, Laravel, Vitest, Jest, Playwright, Storybook, Lighthouse

works.summary: Developed full-stack web applications using Next.js with a modern tech stack (React, Redux, MobX, Tailwind CSS). Configured project deployment on Vercel using Docker and GitHub Actions. Created reusable UI components, admin panels, and interactive interfaces with animations.
description: Developed both frontend and backend parts of applications using Next.js (App Router, Route Handlers, API)
Created and maintained a UI kit for each project
Developed admin panels using Ant Design
Implemented interactive elements with animations (GSAP, Framer Motion)
Implemented custom animations based on mathematical formulas using requestAnimationFrame and Canvas
Configured rendering strategies (SSG, ISR, SSR, dynamic imports, dynamic routes)
Implemented state management using Redux and MobX (shopping cart, calculations, payments)
Implemented integration with Telegram Bot API for sending notifications
achievements: Configured automatic Next.js cache invalidation via WordPress webhooks (Headless): when content is updated in the admin panel, the cache is rebuilt incrementally (ISR), updating only the changed pages
Integrated a payment system with WebSocket-based payment processing, ensuring instant transaction status updates without page reloads
Implemented automatic generation of PDF certificates with dynamic data and email delivery via Nodemailer
works.technologies: TypeScript, React, Next, WordPress, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lighthouse

Integrated payment systems and CMS
Optimized performance (refactoring, Virtual DOM)
Wrote unit tests (Jest), configured deployment and hosting
achievements: Implemented a testing system for an educational platform supporting various question types, answer validation, passing score calculation, and real-time result display

works.summary: Developed web applications within the Shopify ecosystem using Shopify Polaris. Worked on creating a content management system, developing tracking modules, and multilingual solutions.
description: Developed interfaces for Shopify applications using Shopify Polaris UI
Implemented a product tracking system with data analysis and chart visualization
Developed multilingual applications with a subscription system
achievements: Designed the architecture of a Page Builder for a Shopify application with a custom block system, global state management via Redux, and full multilingual support (i18n) for stores in different regions
